title: The outer row context is still available inside a CALCULATE filter argument
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Date'[Year] ), "Previous", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], TREATAS ( { 'Date'[Year] - 1 }, 'Date'[Year] ) ) )

source.quote: Any row context available outside of CALCULATE and CALCULATETABLE is available to filter arguments.
source.supports: the column reference Date[Year] inside the filter argument reads the row context of ADDCOLUMNS, as in the article's YOY-3 measure

source.quote: context transition happens before further filters in CALCULATE
source.supports: the explicit filter on Date[Year] replaces the filter the transition put on the same column

derivation: For 2023 the filter argument is Date[Year] = 2022: no dates, BLANK. For 2024 it is Date[Year] = 2023, which overwrites the transition's filter Date[Year] = 2024: Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 4 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 = 210.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
